answer: LIST st, ci, z, sta FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has SatscoreNumTstTakr t AND ALSO (g / t) AS er AND ALSO has SchoolStreet st AND ALSO has SchoolCity ci AND ALSO has SchoolZip z AND ALSO has SchoolState sta ORDERED WITH er ASCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST n FROM Frpm [has SchoolDOC: '31'] has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e ORDERED WITH e DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
LIST gs FROM School OPTIONALLY has SchoolGSoffered gs AND ALSO has SchoolLongitude lon ORDERED WITH abs(lon) DESCENDING THE FIRST 1

LIST n, dt FROM Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has SchoolSchool n AND ALSO has SchoolDOCType dt AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a AND ALSO (k - a) AS d WHERE d > THE AVERAGE x IN (Frpm [has SchoolFundingType: 'Locally funded'] has FrpmEnrollmentK12 k2 AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentAges517 a2 AND ALSO (k2 - a2) AS x)
LIST n FROM Satscore has SatscoreNumGE1500 g AND ALSO has FrpmSchoolName n AND ALSO has FrpmFreeMealCountK12 fm AND ALSO has FrpmEnrollmentK12 e WHERE g > 0 AND fm / e > 0.1
LIST c, n FROM School s [has SchoolVirtual: 'F'] has SchoolCounty c AND ALSO THE COUNT OF s GROUPED BY c AS n WHERE c = 'San Diego' OR c = 'Santa Barbara' ORDERED WITH n DESCENDING THE FIRST 1
